scope: Three source root causes; generated artifacts, rule configuration, suppressions and unrelated changes left untouched.

rootCauses.name: Parallax layer key precedence
rootCauses.impact: Conditional child-state loss: CMS extension data named key could override the stable layer ID and recreate a layer when it changed. A test reproduced input DOM replacement. No production occurrence claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Place explicit key={_uid} after the spread so the stable CMS identity wins. Layer options, images and other behavior unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: Before-failing test now preserves input node, typed value and focus when spread key changes; speed updates still apply.

rootCauses.name: Decorative tracking pixel accessible name
rootCauses.impact: Small accessibility semantics fix. The non-content tracking image has no useful description and should have empty alternate text. It is already display:none, so normal screen-reader exposure is unlikely; no observed assistive-technology failure claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Add alt="" only. Preserve pixel URLs/count, hidden 1x1 styling and JavaScript tracking setup.
rootCauses.tests: Server-rendered multi-pixel output verifies empty alt for every image, same dimensions/visibility/request URLs, script ID and afterInteractive strategy, per-pixel init and PageView call.

rootCauses.name: App context route/locale synchronization
rootCauses.impact: Consumers briefly receive the previous locale and route when props update, followed by an avoidable corrective render. Regression reproduced two renders instead of one. No production wrong-language flash was observed.
rootCauses.fix: Retain mount-time settings in an initialization snapshot, derive current locale/slug during render and memoize the context value. Remove both synchronizing effects. Preserve the existing mount-time lifetime of defaultLocale, locales, insideStoryblok and extension fields.
rootCauses.tests: Before-failing test now sees one render with current locale/slug; other context fields retain initialization values.

recipeReview: Fetched recipes with no-cache curl and read validation/false-positive checks. Pixel uses the canonical empty-alt fix. Context derives changing values during render; retained initialization-only state is intentional behavior, not an effect-synchronized copy. Key documentation incorrectly instructs key-before-spread, contradicting the actual diagnostic. Followed the stable-identity principle, verified key-after-spread at runtime and confirmed the actual rule clears. No suppression used.
grouping: Two AppProvider derived-state diagnostics share fixGroupId 309f3b1dea840a7e; associated effect-chain diagnostics share the same synchronization root cause. Parallax and pixel are independent roots.

validation.tests: 3 focused regression tests pass across 3 files; all failed before changes
validation.eslint: Six changed source/test files pass without warnings/errors
validation.format: Prettier check and git diff --check pass
validation.limitations: DOM tests use happy-dom with parallax/child mocks; pixel tests render server HTML with Head/Script mocks. No live tracking requests, browser accessibility-tree check or production rebuild performed.

followUp: Other performance/complexity warnings and initial-state computations.
Parallax body overlay still uses a count-based key; review its lifecycle separately if dynamic layer counts are supported.
